h: Joke Jigan reportedly asks where the 'Lagos baddies' were at Zlatan Ibile's wedding
p: Content creator Joke Jigan has reportedly drawn reactions after pointing out the absence of well-known Lagos socialites at Zlatan Ibile's wedding. The remark adds to the ongoing talk about who attended the star-studded event.
more: The wedding has dominated entertainment conversation since the weekend.
Several guests have shared their own clips and photos from the event.
